title: Corporate Sustainability Report 2025: Innovation, Intention and Integrity
summary: SiTime’s 2025 Corporate Sustainability Report highlights progress in energy-efficient precision timing, responsible operations, sustainable supply chains, and long-term environmental impact.
body_markdown:
Image


Today, an organization’s success not only depends on financial performance, but also on how it manages environmental impact, supports its people and contributes to the communities it serves. As part of the $11 billion Timing market, SiTime enables better performance per watt (PPW) across over 400 applications in industries from data centers to wearables. Our[2025 Corporate Sustainability Report](https://www.sitime.com/support/resource-library/sitime-corporate-sustainability-report) has arrived and provides a transparent look at the progress we have made and the priorities guiding our next phase of responsible growth.


Four highlights from this year’s report include:


- **Products—** Precision Timing enables customers to design lower-power, longer-lasting products and to reduce system components. SiTime devices are smaller and use fewer resources than traditional components. All of this translates directly to lower system-wide energy consumption and emissions. This report spotlights sustainable agriculture, seismic sensing for climate solutions, improved patient outcomes and robotics for workplace safety, where our technology contributes to real-world impact.
- **Supply chain—** As a fabless semiconductor company, our progress is strengthened by suppliers who invest in emissions reductions and renewable energy. For example, our foundry, Robert Bosch GmbH has been carbon-neutral in its global operations Scope 1 and 2 emissions since 2020. TSMC is driving to use 60% renewables by 2030 with net-zero emissions by 2050.
- **Operations—** We maintain strong systems for workplace safety, environmental responsibility and regulatory compliance, with regular reviews on pollution prevision, wastewater reduction and water conservation. We’re also continuing to expand our environmental reporting and strengthening governance to ensure accountability.
- **People—** SiTime fosters a culture of respect and empowerment, understanding that diverse perspectives drive smarter, innovative solutions. Human rights sit at the core of our operations, shaping how we engage with global partners to drive dignity, fairness and ethical practices at every level.


SiTime’s singular focus on Precision Timing is what makes us unique. Our silicon MEMS and analog technologies, paired with deep system expertise, deliver high-value solutions for a more sustainable future. We lead with intention in shaping our impact on the world around us, driving toward responsible stewardship with a focus on future generations.


Learn more by downloading the[2025 Corporate Sustainability Report](https://www.sitime.com/support/resource-library/sitime-corporate-sustainability-report)[.](https://www.sitime.com/support/resource-library/sitime-corporate-sustainability-report)
